statement: A versioned external service manifest contract accepts deterministically normalized, digest-pinned OCI artifacts for oci_container and wasm_component runtimes, rejects native_js and runtime/media mismatches with typed errors, and leaves artifact resolution, signature verification, catalog persistence, and activation to their downstream owners.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The contract owner is src/service/external-service-manifest.js, exported through src/service/index.js and proved by test/service/external-service-manifest.test.js via scripts/checks/run-external-service-manifest-contract-scenarios.js; architecture/lagrange-service-manifest.md may be aligned with the executable schema. No other production owner is in scope.

The scenario must reject external native_js and unknown runtimes, unsupported schema versions, missing or malformed sha256 digests, non-OCI packaging, unrecognized media types, and runtime/media mismatches, while accepting both external runtime kinds and ignoring unknown optional fields deterministically.

This Quest validates and normalizes manifest structure only. It must not fetch artifacts, compare resolved bytes with digests, enforce signature policy, persist catalog state, submit lifecycle mutations, or activate runtimes.

Independent verification must show the declared scenario fails when the external manifest owner is reverted or when native_js is admitted, and must verify the exact source patch plus aggregate content before checkpoint and handoff.
